name: heads-up-relay
description: Adds the built-in You should know reviewer's notes to the main conversation as unverified context, without starting a turn. Needs the built-in reviewer, which is not available to every account.

mode.title: Delivery
mode.description: append: add this session's notes to the main conversation for the model to weigh, and take them off the band. log: write notes to the transcript only; the model does not read them. off: do nothing.

receipt.title: Transcript receipt
receipt.description: summary: one line naming each note relayed. expanded: that line followed by the note in full, explanation included, each line marked so no line of it can pass for one the relay wrote.
